roles.title: Junior Statistical Officer (JSO)
roles.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics/Mathematics with minimum 60% marks in Class 12th Mathematics.
roles.description: Responsible for field data collection, sample survey execution, and preliminary data processing.

roles.title: Director of Price Statistics
roles.eligibility: Master's Degree in Economics/Statistics + 5 years experience in Price Index compilation.
roles.description: Oversees CPI (Urban/Rural) compilation, WPI updates, base year revisions, and price trend analysis.

roles.title: Senior Data Analytics Officer
roles.eligibility: B.Tech/M.Sc in Computer Science or Statistics with 3+ years experience in Big Data.
roles.description: Builds automated data pipelines, dashboards, machine learning models, and large-scale census processing.

roles.title: Chief Survey Methodology Officer
roles.description: Oversees large-scale sample survey methodology across all states.

igot_courses.title: Advanced Survey Sampling & Field Data Estimation
igot_courses.provider: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), MoSPI
igot_courses.description: Official NSSTA training module covering Stratified Random Sampling, Cluster Sampling, and Multi-Stage Survey Designs in NSO socio-economic surveys.

igot_courses.title: National Accounts Statistics & GDP Estimation Methodology
igot_courses.description: Comprehensive CSO guide on Gross Value Added (GVA), Gross Domestic Product (GDP), input-output tables, and sector-wise economic estimation.

igot_courses.title: Python & R for Official Data Processing & Analytics
igot_courses.provider: MoSPI Digital Capacity Division & NITI Aayog
igot_courses.description: Hands-on data cleaning using Pandas, exploratory data analysis, and automated report generation for official government statisticians.

igot_courses.title: Index Numbers: Consumer Price Index (CPI) & WPI Calculation
igot_courses.description: Methodology for Laspeyres price index formula, base year updating, weighting diagrams, and item basket selection for CPI urban and rural.

igot_courses.title: Data Governance, Security & GIGW Compliance in Government Systems
igot_courses.provider: DARPG & Ministry of Electronics and IT (MeitY)
igot_courses.description: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW 3.0), data privacy protocols, and secure microdata handling in public administrative systems.
